tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: The ground. Page background, text on filled buttons and on a selected door.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: All text and hairlines on ink. Filled button background.

tokens.name: dim
tokens.usage: Labels and secondary text on ink. Never below 11px.

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and empty meter tracks. Decorative only, never text.

tokens.name: dawn
tokens.usage: Reserved for morning: the one action that ends the game, and the breathing light.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: The tide marker when it is off level. A state colour, never decoration.

families.mono: "DM Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: title
styles.usage: The game title only. Scales down to 60px on phones.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Place names and verdicts. Scales down to 40px.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Tuesday came for all of it.
styles.usage: The narrator speaking inside a door. Scales down to 22px.

styles.name: lesson
styles.sample: Even the small ones are loans.
styles.usage: What a door taught. Status line in the night.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: For a few years I opened every door I was offered.
styles.usage: Upright running text. Max 54 characters wide.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Anything measured: meters, eyebrows, door names, buttons. Always uppercase.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Door names inside the arch. The smallest text in the system.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Label to value inside a meter.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between gems and between stacked lessons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between doors. Diamond to text in a lesson.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between blocks in a text anchor. Minimum screen gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Column gap in stats. Pitch of the cover pattern.

tokens.name: space-gutter
tokens.usage: Maximum screen gutter on wide screens. The gutter is clamp(18px, 4.5vw, 72px).

tokens.name: radius-arch
tokens.usage: The top corners of a door. Nothing else is round except the breathing light.

tokens.name: radius-foot
tokens.usage: The bottom corners of a door.

tokens.name: radius-square
tokens.usage: Buttons, meters and every other edge.

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: Hover on a filled button.

tokens.name: glow-dawn
tokens.usage: The morning button when it becomes available.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: As text-shadow under every line that sits on a live world. This is what keeps text legible.
